pure-announcement.rationale: This is the vendor's own release note — 'Today we added new guides for' five named sandbox providers — and beyond that day's documentation drop it carries no idea that transfers past the Claude Managed Agents product.

duplicate.rationale: No nearest concept covers managed-agent sandbox hosting, so the announcement is not redundant with the corpus — it simply is not a concept.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The claim that these provider guides exist is directly checkable against the vendor's documentation.

durability.rationale: A dated provider-support list ('today we added guides') is a vendor feature matrix that will be stale as soon as the roster changes.

actionability.rationale: The only available action is the product-only step of picking one of the five listed providers and following its guide.

atomicity.rationale: It carries exactly one thin message — managed agents can run in a sandbox you control, and guides now exist — easily stated in a sentence.
